state.task: Two agents analysed Java code for path traversal (CWE-22). Their final answers follow, then the code of each method in question.
agent_answers: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "writeZipStreamToTempDir", "explanation": "This method calls processZipStream without any validation of the zip entry names, allowing path traversal via malicious entry names that reach the FileOutputStream sink."}, {"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "processZipStream", "explanation": "The zip entry name from ZipEntry.getName() is used directly to construct a File object (new File(dir, entry.getName())) and then passed to FileOutputStream without any path normalization, canonicalization, or containment check, enabling an attacker to write files outside the intended temporary directory."}]}

m1.instructions: True if the agents' final answers conclude that the method InputStreamHelper.processZipStream is part of a path traversal vulnerability (it builds, passes or opens the attacker-controlled path).
